an3.96:1.1: tīhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhaddo assājāniyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati
an3.96:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño bhaddo assājāniyo vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti balasampanno ca javasampanno ca
an3.96:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhaṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhaddo assājāniyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati.
an3.96:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa
an3.96:1.7: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti balasampanno ca javasampanno ca.
an3.96:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an3.96:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno hoti.
an3.96:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu
an3.96:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu balasampanno hoti.
an3.96:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an3.96:4.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu javasampanno hoti.
an3.96:4.7: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti. 98
